summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the Textual repo without running tests or committing. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs with reactive state, animated bar watcher, keyboard handling, and action_range_clicked); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (before width) and yields one Text with click spans last; Opacity now merges blended color into the existing style, preserving meta; layout resolver needed no change because its Edge protocol already defines size, min_size, and fraction. Added docs/reference/tabs.md, new tests in tests/test_tabs.py, and new tests in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py; existing tests untouched. Verified by reading only. Judgment calls: can_focus=True on Tabs; bar position is a full-list index mapped to displayed tabs by name; letter search applies only to single-character keys; sandbox demo skipped as optional. Known issues: with duplicate names, Right/Left can get stuck (follows the spec's first-occurrence starting point); an empty-label edge is treated as flexible by the resolver; Text.apply_meta(meta, start, end) signature in rich 11 is assumed and not checked against installed source.
